_about: List prices used by scripts/eval/cost-model.mjs. USD unless stated. Every figure must be verified against the account's actual plan before publication; 'checked' is the date the public page was read. Sources are public pricing pages; 'unverified' means the page could not be fetched on that date and the figure comes from a secondary source.
